summary: Agrico is a Dutch cooperative that breeds potato varieties through Agrico Research and sells seed potatoes in more than 80 countries. It is based in Emmeloord, the Netherlands. Its forerunners PZVB, DTV and Zuiderzeepolders joined forces in 1973, and more than 1,200 growers are members.
ownership: Cooperative with more than 1,200 member growers
products: Varieties for fries, chips, retail and traditional export markets
Seed lot quality testing at the Agrico Quality Center
